title: Product Tank Tallinn 🚀🤖
content:
Product Tank Tallinn 🚀🤖

Yesterday, I went to Microsoft for Product Tank Tallinn. The topic this time: How to use LLMs in product management. From copilots 🧑‍✈️ to agents 🤝, the discussions were buzzing. During Q\&A, someone introduced me to Linear — honestly feels like Jira, but on steroids 💉⚡.

And guess what? Every single time I visit Microsoft... it’s magically a sunny day 🌞✨. Either I’m really lucky or the building has a secret weather API.



Spotted the Skype logo 👀.
Kinda sad it’s gone 💔, but let’s be honest — as a communication tool, it’s like bringing a floppy disk to a cloud conference ☁️😂. Still, the logo looks so mordern.



Also found a self-serve weighing machine ⚖️. For a second, I thought I was back in Shenzhen 🇨🇳.



Tallinn tech events never disappoint. Free knowledge, sunny weather, and random office gym vibes 💪😂.
